تستحصلي (form X)
# تَسْتَحْصِلِي (tastaḥṣilī) /tas.taħ.sˤi.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْصَلَ (istaḥṣala)
# تُسْتَحْصَلِي (tustaḥṣalī) /tus.taħ.sˤa.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْصَلَ (istaḥṣala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
